title: Publication secret-value refusal
description: Exercise evidence refresh through an isolated gateway with synthetic secret and clean recorded packages. External publication is captured by the proof environment. No live PR, run or credential is modified.

proofTargets.claim: A synthetic secret in frozen recorded input refuses evidence publication with a fingerprint and recovery action.
Clean selected evidence reaches the existing publication transport.

refresh-secret.cmd: FARMSLOT_GATEWAY="{{params.gateway_url}}" node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway run.refreshPublishedEvidence '{"runId":"{{params.secret_run_id}}"}' > "$FARMSLOT_RECIPE_ARTIFACTS_DIR/refusal.txt" 2>&1; node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const t=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");console.log(JSON.stringify({refused:t.includes("Publication blocked by secret values:")&&/sha256:[a-f0-9]{12}/.test(t)&&t.includes("refresh the gate package")}));' "$FARMSLOT_RECIPE_ARTIFACTS_DIR/refusal.txt"
refresh-secret.intent: Request publication of the selected synthetic secret fixture through the gateway.

assert-refusal.intent: The public request refuses using fingerprints and the supported recovery action.

refresh-clean.intent: Refresh the clean selected package through the same production path.

assert-clean.intent: The clean control completes evidence publication.
